proposal.summary: Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 contains a memory leak that can be triggered remotely by a client sending many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs and failing to respond to PUBREC; the root cause is mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.
proposal.cwe_quote: has a memory leak that can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands. This occurs because of mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue by connecting a client that sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs and does not respond to PUBREC; monitor broker memory usage and capture logs to confirm leak and locate the mishandling of EAGAIN in send paths. If confirmed, backport or apply the vendor fix (upgrade to 2.0.16 or later).
